speaker: Leone
original_jp: 体の中に神の力と精神が宿るってどんな感じなのかしら…
original_en:
What does it feel like to have the power
and spirit of a god living inside you?

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …どうしたのですか いきなり？
original_en: Why do you ask, all of a sudden?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: ちょっと気になっただけよ
original_en: Oh, I'm just curious, is all.

speaker: Alicia
original_en: For a long time, it was a burden.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 父にも母にも愛されず〓まれて〓まれて国を追われ <PART> ――
original_en:
My parents didn't love me. I was
alienated, despised...and then banished
from the kingdom.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私にとって〓めしいだけでした
original_en: I felt as if I was cursed.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 彼女なしには故国もミッドガルドも救う事ができません…
original_en:
Without Silmeria I wouldn't be able to
save Midgard or my homeland.

speaker: Alicia
original_en: Or to save myself from my own fate.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 余計な事を聞いてしまったようね…
original_en: I should have minded my own business.
